spans.s:
उनत्ति, उनति /unatti/ /unati/ 

unátti, undati quillt, benetzt, badet / springs, wets,
bathes, s. udán.

ऊनः /ūnaḥ/ 

ūnáḥ unzureichend, ermangelnd / defective, wanting,
= aw. úno dss., vgl. np. vang leer, arm, pām. vanao Leerheit, Eitelkeit, arm. unain leer (WP I 108), gr. Elvis ermangelnd, lat. vānus leer (doch s. WP a.a.O.), got. wans ermangelnd, fehlend, ferner viell. toch. A wärce schwach, mangelhaft (? — Van Windekens 157).
